transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

I'm just really struggling with how my face looks, especially my skin and my nose. I have these horrible scars and my nose looks completely misshapen, and it just ruins my entire appearance. Everyone tells me it's not that bad, but I can't stand how I look.

How much time each day do you spend thinking about these concerns about your face, and do you find yourself repeatedly checking mirrors, comparing yourself to others, or trying to hide or fix the areas you dislike?

I spend hours every single day, almost constantly, obsessing over how my face looks. I'm always checking mirrors, comparing my skin and nose to everyone I see, and trying to hide my flaws with layers of makeup. I also spend a lot of time picking at my skin to try and 'fix' the spots, even though I know it probably makes it worse.
Aside from worrying about your appearance, have you been feeling down most of the day or lost interest in things you usually enjoy for at least two weeks?
No, I wouldn't say I've been feeling down or lost interest in my usual activities. My general mood is okay, it's really just the constant worry and stress about how I look that's bothering me.
Do you ever feel completely certain that your face looks deformed or abnormal, even when other people tell you they do not see it that way?

Yes, I am absolutely certain that my nose is crooked and my face looks deformed. My family and friends constantly reassure me and say they don't see anything wrong, but I just can't believe them. The flaws are so incredibly obvious and distressing to me, I don't understand how they don't see it.
Do you also have unwanted repetitive thoughts or rituals about things other than your appearance, like contamination, checking, counting, or needing things to feel just right?
No, I don't experience any of those kinds of thoughts or rituals like contamination or counting. My worries and habits are strictly focused on my face and how I look.
Are your beliefs and behaviors mainly centered on your appearance, or do you also have other fixed beliefs that people are trying to harm you, watch you, or deceive you?
No, I don't have any thoughts like that at all. My worries are strictly focused on my face and how ugly I look, not about people trying to harm or watch me. It really is just about my own appearance.
